title: Can AI Mature a Model's Geometry? Training-Free Weight Baking in LLMs
read_level: partial (arXiv HTML v1 main text Secs 1-7 read in full; Appendices A-O, incl. per-run tables and analyst prompt, not read)
why_wsp: A small analyst LLM reads a fixed-size digest of topological descriptors (not raw weights) of a target model's layer and proposes affine residual-stream operations, which closed-form ridge regression bakes into the FFN output projection, layer by layer.
domain: LLM representation geometry (category purity/silhouette/anisotropy of word representations)
editor: Main study analyst: Gemma-2-2B; round robin: Gemma-2-2B, Llama-3.2-3B, Phi-3-mini, Qwen2.5-1.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B (never self)
target: Main: Qwen2.5-1.5B and SmolLM2-1.7B; round robin adds Llama-3.2-3B, Phi-3-mini, Gemma-2-2B (1.5-3.8B params); edits written into FFN output projection of each block
interface: closed form (analyst emits JSON ops from a fixed edit language; ridge regression computes Delta W)
loop: closed-loop with feedback (sequential per-layer loop; up to three proposals per layer, measured numbers returned after rejection; two-stage verification)
self_editing: no; 'A model is never its own analyst' (letting a model edit itself listed as future work)
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: "relative weight change below the budget of 0.10" per edited projection (Sec 5.1); 'every edit was written into one feed-forward output projection'

headline_results.quote: in all six default runs, the analyst's edits raised category purity on unseen words in unseen templates
purity under [D] rose at 150 of the 156 layers of the six edited models
Qwen LLM arm 0.0196–0.0287 ... SmolLM2 LLM arm 0.0104–0.0117
No benchmark change was detectable at this sample size (standard error about 0.035 for 200 examples; every change was at most 0.030)
higher than the default heuristic's in three of the six pairs and lower in three ... in all six pairs its cumulative KL was lower and its CKA to the original model higher
with P and S alone the gain on SmolLM2 was negative in all three runs
the parallel mode raised the cumulative KL by a factor of 7.7 to 14.6 and held-out perplexity by more than 100%
In 16 of the 20 pairs the analyst changed its target, and in all 16 purity under [D] rose over the edited layers
With 16 categories, the analyst's purity gain under [D] was negative in five of six runs

cost.quote: the cumulative KL was 0.083 to 0.104 nats per token in the LLM arm, well within the budget of 0.30
The truth margin of the factual probe fell in all 18 default runs, by at most 8.1% of the baseline margin
a single local GPU, an NVIDIA H100 with 80 GB of memory
cost.where: Sec 4.1 (no token or time totals found in main text)

baselines_and_controls: Deterministic category-aware heuristic arm (no LLM) under same limits; hybrid arm; parallel (non-sequential) control; descriptor-level ablation; strength, gain-threshold and category-count ablations (heuristic only for strength/threshold). No steering or closed-form editing baselines ('which we did not run').
runs_and_variance: 126 runs in main study (seeds 0,1,2 per configuration) plus 20 round-robin runs (seed 0); ranges over seeds reported. Quote: 'seeds are not independent replications and the tests we quote are descriptive' (Sec 4.3)
robustness_of_edits: Transfer to unseen words and unseen sentence templates tested (retention 0.73 to 1.69 on Qwen); no fine-tuning/quantization tests
verification: Two-stage verification: intervention test then re-test on baked model against limits (per-edit KL <=0.05, cumulative <=0.30 nats/token; guard perplexity; CKA >=0.95; relative weight change <=0.10). Statistical, not formal.
memorization_vs_reasoning: Descriptor ablation shows gains depend on digest content; authors note 'the analyst's written rationales are short and often generic ... so our conclusions rest on measured outcomes'.
limitations_stated: One analyst and two targets in main study; models <=3.8B; single-seed round robin; seeds descriptive; rationales generic; ablations of strength/threshold heuristic-only; uncurated WordNet vocabulary; held-out perplexity rose; no steering/editing baselines.
notes_for_survey: Variant of WSP where the editor sees only a compressed descriptor digest, not raw weights, and a closed-form ridge solve writes the change. Editors are 1.5-3.8B open models rather than frontier LLMs. Outcome is a geometry metric (category purity) with benchmarks unchanged within sampling error.
